title: The Most Overlooked Path to Wealth
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest is building a franchise education/matching platform and invites viewers to work with them

idea.name: Home-based freight brokerage franchise
idea.one_liner: Franchise where you sell B2B freight matching from home; franchisor supplies tech, carriers, back office and leads for 30% of gross margin
idea.offer: freight brokerage between shippers and carriers
idea.revenue_model: spread between shipper price and carrier cost (~40% margin), less 30% royalty on margin

key_quotes.quote: They charge 30% royalty on the gross margin, not on the revenue.
They handle they're running all of your invoicing, carrier payments, carrier relationships.

claims.quote: So, the average franchisee in this business is doing over a million dollars a year in revenue.
So the freight brokerage one because you're doing it at your home, small office, small team, it's mostly you B2B sales, it's 75,000 to 193,000.

ideas.delivery: franchisor tech platform and carrier network
ideas.other_uk_rules: Concept originates in UK/Europe; no operator licence needed for brokering only

idea.name: Commercial facility management franchise
idea.one_liner: One-stop maintenance contractor for office/warehouse owners, subcontracting janitorial, landscaping, HVAC, striping
idea.revenue_model: marked-up subcontracted services; 5% royalty on gross sales

key_quotes.quote: It's one, for lack of a better word, one throat to choke.
It's fundamentally a sales leadership business.

claims.quote: The highest grossing revenue franchisee in 2025 in their FDD did over $50 million in revenue.
So 33.5% margin off of an average of 9.8 million.
The total range that they have is 229,000 up to 410,000.

acquisition_channels.details: franchisee's own sales; brand and some national relationships

idea.name: Mobile fryer oil filtration route franchise
idea.one_liner: Trucks filter restaurant fryer oil on site, replace and resell spent oil for biofuel, and upsell drain and refrigeration cleaning
idea.offer: on-site oil filtration, oil supply, waste oil removal, drain and fridge cleaning
idea.revenue_model: recurring route service fees plus oil sales and waste-oil resale

key_quotes.quote: They run a hose into the building through the back door and they filter that oil on site.
So, I've made money twice here in this instance that you're happy and, you know, thrilled about.

claims.quote: It's 517,000 in revenue for one territory.
And they have 377 territories across 119 franchises.
It's as soon as you start with one 140,000 to 163,000.

claims.claim: Independent operator has run similar oil plus hood-vent business 20 years
claims.quote: He doesn't own a franchise. He's he's ran it for 20 years.

ideas.delivery: proprietary filtration trucks on a route

uk_legal_risk.reason: Collecting and transporting used cooking oil is controlled waste: needs waste carrier/broker registration and waste transfer notes

idea.name: On-site fleet fuel and DEF delivery franchise
idea.one_liner: Deliver diesel and DEF to trucking yards and heavy equipment on site so fleets skip fuel stops

key_quotes.quote: They're walking away with a little over a million in gross profit.

claims.quote: So this one is pretty interesting. The average revenue is just under 5 million.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Fuel delivery requires ADR-compliant vehicles and trained drivers, plus petroleum storage/dispensing regulations

idea.name: Card My Yard celebration yard-sign franchise
idea.one_liner: $10k franchise renting 'happy birthday' style lawn sign displays in suburbs, a modern paper-round side hustle

key_quotes.quote: It's almost like art the modern paper boy route I would say.

claims.quote: And you can make 30-ish grand a year doing that.

idea.name: Garage renovation franchise (epoxy floors, slatwall)
idea.one_liner: Two-to-three person crews pour epoxy garage floors and hang custom shelving; no heavy equipment, average revenue over $1M

key_quotes.quote: It's just a team of two or three individuals coming to pour the epoxy and and hang shelving.

claims.quote: They do like epoxied floors, custom shelving with slapboard and stuff. The average revenue is over a million.

stated_problem.quote: Every city we call doing this wait list wait list 6 months 12 months every city.
stated_problem.speaker: Alex

idea.name: Senior home accessibility installation franchise
idea.one_liner: Install ramps, stairlifts and grab rails for ageing homeowners, often insurance-paid, in-and-out 'grandparent business'

key_quotes.quote: You're coming in, you put a handrail next to the toilet, thousand bucks, I'm out.

claims.quote: And one of the brands I'm thinking of is, you know, 10 million plus a year in revenue, very good margin.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK funding via Disabled Facilities Grants from councils rather than insurance; stairlifts fall under LOLER inspection

idea.name: Multi-unit development of an emerging food franchise (Pop-Up Bagels)
idea.one_liner: Invest early in a young franchise brand to develop 10 units, with an equity-incentivised operating partner running them

key_quotes.quote: I'm developing 10 pop-up bagels right now.
I like getting in at these like threes or fours because I have more upside because sometimes they'll you can get equity.
